# 9-man sample and held-out crop

The candidate template `templates/client/9m__cd82_friend.png` is the leftmost tile in the CPU three-player friend-match screenshot `sanma-run-cd82c23-20261101/manual-1-before.png`, crop `(223,921)-(315,1072)` from the 1920×1080 RGB image. The original screenshot SHA-256 is `abe18e6467dede9664e9836665ed877267ac8859cb03f4ba910ea802bde9906a`; the PNG crop SHA-256 is `24310679f63cbed8d0e0fa2e0dd687efacb73879cf8e2fbf2189774ec35c77c7`. The glyph was visually reviewed as 9-man. It contains the tile only and no names or avatars.

`9m-7e-heldout.png` is the drawn tile from a separate CPU friend match screenshot `sanma-run-7e79853-20261101/check5.png`, crop `(1486,921)-(1578,1072)`. Original screenshot SHA-256 `b24c9bab3d642e2c76853c2e5d1ce6f4599b844824f880ce0bca3202ce999f2d`; crop SHA-256 `0a2c3b3778865aa7681c008626a9a54887aed303645b3599cf1ca3c570e2d7fb`. It was visually reviewed as 9-man. The crop differs in SHA from the candidate and all evaluated bootstrap files. A different crop of cd82c23 `manual-24-before.png` was pixel-identical to this held-out crop and explicitly was not used as a training sample. Different screenshots and hashes do not prove independent rendering or complete coverage of lighting and themes.

With the original bootstrap template set on the evaluation host, the held-out crop classified as 9m at confidence 0.958255 and runner-up 0.771086; adding the sample yielded 0.999834 and runner-up 0.748639. The 105 filename-designated holdout crops had no newly introduced high-confidence misclassifications and no changed classifications; the uniquely identified red 5-man holdout uses the documented visual label correction in `test/clientFourPinTemplate.test.ts`. The sample and target had no exact SHA duplicates among those bootstrap files.

Two manually labelled four-player images in `test/fixtures/` remained 28/28 correct and all classifier results were unchanged. Neither image contains 9m; their independence and coverage are limited. The crop-level and screenshot checks do not establish correct full-hand recognition, action eligibility, game results or win-rate improvement. The full template evaluation test skips if the local bootstrap dataset is unavailable. The installer performs only an explicit between-match installation, rejects a different existing file, and requires restarting any recognizer that has already loaded templates.

The reproducible combination test builds two isolated template directories. Both receive the tracked 4p, 3s and 8s samples explicitly, and the proposed set additionally receives the tracked 9m sample. Existing same-named host entries are excluded from the isolated directories and hashed before/after to verify preservation; they are not overwritten. Thus the combination under test does not depend on whether those four samples have been installed on the host. The underlying bootstrap training and 105-crop holdout dataset is still required; without it, the evaluation is skipped or cannot complete, and these results should not be assumed.
